standard.summary: ToMe 每步合并的 token 比例（0~1），tome_enabled 开启时生效。默认 0.5。
standard.effect: 比例越高参与 attention 的 token 越少、前向越快，但特征分辨率损失越大；0 等效于不合并。
standard.whenToUse: 开启 ToMe 后从 0.3~0.5 起步，观察速度收益与预览图质量的平衡点。
standard.avoidWhen: tome_enabled 关闭时无意义；比例 >0.6 时细节退化通常肉眼可见，不建议用于最终产出训练。

standard_en.summary: The proportion of tokens ToMe merges each step (0~1), effective when tome_enabled is on. Defaults to 0.5.
standard_en.effect: The higher the ratio, the fewer tokens take part in attention and the faster the forward pass, but the more feature resolution is lost; 0 is equivalent to no merging.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start at 0.3~0.5 once ToMe is on, and watch where the speed gain balances against preview image quality.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Meaningless when tome_enabled is off; above 0.6 the detail degradation is usually visible to the eye, so it is inadvisable for training you intend to ship.

advanced.principle: ToMe 的合并数量 r = ratio × token 数；合并按 token 相似度贪心配对，加权平均后序列长度缩短，attention 复杂度从 O(N²) 降到 O((N-r)²)。
advanced.intervention: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam 把 ratio 传入 build_tome_seam；tome_runtime.py 在模型前向作用域内应用。
advanced.expectedImpact: attention 耗时按 (1-ratio)² 量级下降；高分辨率（token 多）时绝对收益更大。
advanced.tradeoffs: 速度与质量单调互换；训练时合并、推理时不合并造成的训推差异随 ratio 增大。

advanced_en.principle: ToMe's merge count r = ratio × token count; merging greedily pairs tokens by similarity and averages them weighted, shortening the sequence and dropping attention complexity from O(N²) to O((N-r)²).
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop.py:_get_tome_seam passes the ratio into build_tome_seam; tome_runtime.py applies it within the model forward scope.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Attention time falls on the order of (1-ratio)²; the absolute benefit is larger at high resolution (many tokens).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Speed and quality trade off monotonically; the train/inference gap from merging during training but not inference grows with ratio.
